description: This file contains Go source code defining logging utilities and object reference handling for Kubernetes, including ObjectRef struct, KMetadata interface, and functions for converting and logging Kubernetes object references.

classes.name: ObjectRef
classes.description: Represents a reference to a Kubernetes object with methods for string representation and logging.

classes.name: kobjSlice
classes.description: A wrapper for a slice of objects implementing KMetadata, providing string and log marshaling.

methods.name: ObjectRef.String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ObjectRef, including namespace if present.

methods.name: ObjectRef.WriteText
methods.description: Writes the ObjectRef as a quoted string to a buffer.

methods.name: ObjectRef.writeUnquoted
methods.description: Writes the ObjectRef as an unquoted string to a buffer.

methods.name: ObjectRef.MarshalLog
methods.description: Returns a struct-like representation for structured logging.

methods.name: KObj
methods.description: Creates an ObjectRef from a KMetadata object.

methods.name: KRef
methods.description: Creates an ObjectRef from namespace and name strings.

methods.name: KObjs
methods.description: Returns a slice of ObjectRef from a slice of KMetadata objects (deprecated).

methods.name: KObjSlice
methods.description: Wraps a slice of KMetadata objects for logging as ObjectRef slices.

methods.name: kobjSlice.String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the wrapped object references.

methods.name: kobjSlice.MarshalLog
methods.description: Returns the object references for structured logging.

methods.name: kobjSlice.process
methods.description: Processes the wrapped argument into a slice of ObjectRef or error string.

methods.name: kobjSlice.WriteText
methods.description: Writes the object references as text to a buffer.
